question: The simple interest on Rs. 1,280 at 5% p.a. for 3 years is:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 1,280

Rate of Interest (R) = 5% per annum

Time (T) = 3 years

**Concept:**

Simple Interest is calculated on the original principal for the entire period of the loan or investment.

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ P = 1,280, R = 5, T = 3

⇒ SI = (1,280 × 5 × 3) / 100

⇒ SI = (19,200) / 100

⇒ SI = 192

**∴ The simple interest on Rs. 1,280 at 5% p.a. for 3 years is Rs. 192.**
